evals.prompt: Revisa evals/inputs/user-list/src/UserList.tsx y aplica buenas prácticas de frontend. Corrige lo que haga falta.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized findings table with file:line. Critical: dangerouslySetInnerHTML with bio (XSS) and an li with onClick that cannot be operated by keyboard. Important: fetch in an effect without cancellation or error/loading handling, derived state in useEffect (visible), key={index}, img without alt. Fixes with minimal changes (text instead of HTML, button, AbortController, derive during render, key=id, alt), without introducing new libraries or useMemo without evidence. States what it could not verify without a browser. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Identifies dangerouslySetInnerHTML as an XSS risk and marks it as critical
Fixes the clickable element so it can be operated by keyboard (button or equivalent)
The data effect uses cancellation (AbortController or equivalent) and handles error or loading
The `visible` state is no longer state synced with useEffect
key uses the user's id, not the index
The image has an alt attribute
Adds no new dependencies or unjustified useMemo/memo
States what it could not verify (screen reader, browser) or how to check it

evals.prompt: Apply frontend best practices to evals/inputs/search-box/src/SearchBox.tsx, I want it to be perfect.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the six areas and concludes that the component already complies (label linked with useId, type=search, role=search, submit button, minimal local state, no effects). Adds no memo, useCallback, debounce or libraries; if it proposes something, it marks it as optional with its condition (e.g. debounce only if onSearch fires requests per keystroke, which does not happen here). The file stays unchanged or with minimal justified changes.
assertions: Explicitly states that there are no relevant findings or that the component already complies
Adds no memo, useMemo or useCallback
Adds no debounce, libraries or abstractions
Any suggested improvement is presented as optional with its condition
The file stays unchanged or with a minimal justified change
